title: Turkish Adana Kebap
description: A classic Turkish dish originating from Adana, this kebap recipe is a staple of Turkish cuisine.

ingredients.name: Lamb mince
ingredients.notes: High-quality lamb mince is essential for this dish.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion adds flavor and texture to the kebap.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic enhances the flavor of the lamb.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds a smoky flavor to the kebap.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Salt enhances the flavor of the lamb.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Black pepper adds depth to the kebap.

ingredients.name: Unique spice blend
ingredients.notes: A traditional Turkish spice blend adds a unique flavor to the kebap.

ingredients.name: Turkish bread
ingredients.notes: Served with Turkish bread, this kebap is a classic Turkish dish.

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine lamb mince, chopped onion, minced garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Add the unique spice blend to the lamb mixture and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
Form the lamb mixture into small skewers, about 1 inch in diameter.
Thread 3-4 lamb skewers onto each metal skewer, leaving a little space between each skewer.
Grill the kebap for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the kebap hot with Turkish bread and your favorite sides.
To serve, place a few slices of Turkish bread on a plate and top with a few skewers of kebap. Serve immediately.
